decision_conditions: <p><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt"><span style="font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif">The proposed rear and side extension would have create overbearing development which would create a sense of enclosure and loss of outlook to both the neighbouring occupiers at no.14 and no.18 Cooper Avenue which would detriment the existing level of amenity felt at these properties which is therefore unacceptable in accordance with Policy 57 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024). </span></span></span></p><p><br data-cke-eol="1"></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt;">The proposed rear dormer extension by reason of its&nbsp;size, design and massing would appear unsubordinate and excessively large to the roofslope which would&nbsp;detract from the and apperance of the dwellinghouse by appearing top-heavy, and therefore the development would be unacceptable in accordance with policy 53 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024).&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The combination of the part single, part two-storey side extension with the wrap around rear extension and roof extensions all&nbsp;within this planning application would significantly detract and subdue from the original character of the dwelling and would create extremely unsubordinate and obtrusive development to the dwellinghouse which would set a negative precedent and would degrade the character of properties in this area. The development is not compliant with policy 53 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024).</span></span></p>

<p><span style="line-height:normal"><span style="font-size:12.0pt">The wraparound rear and side extension by reason of its excessive massing, design, sitting and appearance would introduce an unsubordinate and inharmonious form of development to the dwellinghouse which is not in keeping and would detract from the existing and original style, size and appearance of the dwellinghouse causing harm to the dwelling and wider area which is not compliant with policy 53 of Waltham Forests LP1 (2024).</span></span></p>
description: Construction of a part-single, part-two storey side extension, single storey rear extension, hip to gable and rear dormer extension with the installation of three rooflights to front roof slope.
